boundary: The six exterior-transposition choices are not closed under local gauge transformations, so their unrestricted local-assignment set has no intrinsic gauge quotient until a gauge-stable closure is specified. The exact quotient stated here is for all reversible S5-valued connections.

canonical_order_statistic_sector.conclusion: All six Pass-596 order-statistic connections are distinct gauge classes, including the two reversal pairs with equal Wilson sums.

complete_reversible_S5_connection_quotie.normal_form: Set every spanning-tree edge to identity; the remaining 365 loop holonomies are an element of S5^365 modulo simultaneous conjugation.

theorem: The full gauge quotient of reversible S5-valued connections is exactly the simultaneous-conjugacy quotient S5^365/S5, with the displayed Burnside count. The six canonical exterior-order rules occupy six distinct classes.

triangle_complex.interpretation: The 2-skeleton has no abelian one-cycle sector in the tested characteristics; this does not by itself prove the nonabelian fundamental group trivial.
